description: Export a 'todo' board's columns + tasks as a single text document. `format` is 'markdown' (a checklist grouped by column, the default) or 'csv' (one row per task with column/name/priority/assignee/due_date/done). Returns the rendered text. Same data as the GET /api/boards/<id>/tasks.md and tasks.csv REST endpoints.

access_key.description: 8-character lowercase alphanumeric board access key when the board is locked (legacy 6-character lowercase alphanumeric keys are also accepted). Equivalent to setting the `X-Board-Key` HTTP header on the JSON-RPC POST. Omit for unlocked boards. Obtain via POST /api/boards/<id>/lock.

name: export_tasks
title: Export Tasks
